goal: Prevent node crashes and denial-of-service risks caused by unbounded IPC connections exhausting file descriptors
Allow node operators to set separate connection limits tailored to different IPC listener roles
reviewability: Review is worthwhile now with no blocking dependencies or required rebases
agreement: Strong support for per-address limits and descriptor accounting fixes (ryanofsky, kevkevinpal)
Verified by testing connection limits and backlog handling on macOS and Linux (xyzconstant)
Concept approval for cleaner listener configuration and future extensibility (Sjors, ViniciusCestarii)
Minor open suggestion on help text phrasing and release notes documentation (sedited)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it removes a denial-of-service and crash risk from unbounded IPC connection exhaustion
Integrates IPC sockets into startup file descriptor reservations while enabling flexible per-listener limits
